description: A list average follows pushes and pops
code:
temps = [18, 22]
mean = temps.average()
temps.push(26)
assert(mean, 22)
temps.pop()
mean

description: A selector averages a property over every instance of a class
code:
class Order(total):
    this.total = total
Order(20)
Order(45)
typical = Order.average(.total)
Order(35)
typical

description: Averaging an empty list or a class without instances gives NaN, which Number.isNaN tells apart from null
code:
class Refund
pending = []
[Number.isNaN(pending.average()), Number.isNaN(Refund.average(refund -> refund.amount)), pending.average() == null]

description: Averaged values convert to numbers and every item counts, so null and an empty string count zero
A class-level rule averages the readings of each room
code:
class Room(name, temps):
    this.name = name
    this.temps = temps
$Room.mean = $Room.temps.average()
lab = Room("lab", [20, 24])
lab.temps.push(28)
lab.mean

description: A filtered average divides by the matching items only and stays live
code:
class Order(total, rush):
    this.total = total
    this.rush = rush
rushed = Order.filter(.rush).average(.total)
Order(20, false)
Order(45, true)
Order(35, true)
rushed

description: An average equals the sum divided by the length, bit for bit
code:
values = [0.1, 0.2, 0.3]
[values.average(), values.sum() / values.length, values.average() == values.sum() / values.length]

description: An average selector that is not a function raises a TypeError
code:
failure = ""
try:
    [1, 2].average(5)
catch error:
    failure = error
failure
